blogs.title: From Code to Calculus: Why Programming Skills Boost Mathematical AI
blogs.description: Explore the surprising link between code training and math reasoning in large language models. This post decodes the experiments that show code tokens help models solve both pure math questions and program‑aided proofs, and discusses what it means for future AI‑in‑education tools.

blogs.title: Mining Math from the Web: Building a 120‑Billion‑Token Corpus in Minutes
blogs.description: Take a behind‑the‑scenes tour of the DeepSeekMath data pipeline: how a fastText classifier, domain heuristics, and iterative refinement turned Common Crawl into a multilingual math goldmine. Readers’ll learn how to replicate this technique for their own niche corpora.

blogs.title: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO): Reinforcement Learning Made Lean for LLMs
blogs.description: Demystify GRPO, a lightweight RL variant of PPO that cuts memory usage by dropping the critic. The article walks through the math, shows why group‑based baselines work for token‑reward tasks, and presents concrete gains on GSM8K and MATH benchmarks.

blogs.title: Open‑Source Math Machines on Speed‑Dial: DeepSeekMath vs GPT‑4 & Gemini Ultra
blogs.description: A comparative rundown of where open‑source models stand today. We'll cover benchmark scores across English and Chinese tasks, illustrate self‑consistency improvements, and explain why DeepSeekMath’s 7B capacity rivals 70B closed models in many areas.

blogs.title: Beyond Benchmarks: Strengths & Gaps in Modern Math LLMs
blogs.description: An honest review of DeepSeekMath’s performance—stellar on grade‑school to college problems but still lagging on geometry and theorem proving. The blog will also touch on limitations like few‑shot learning gaps and come with suggestions for future corpus expansion.
